title: Prime-Seq Protocol for RNA Preparation
author: Aleksandar Janjic
materials: Thaw frozen buffers and primers on ice
Weigh the tissue and add to tube

Homogenize the tissue, while making sure to keep the samples cold We have successfully used the Qiagen Tissue Lyzer, at 50 oscillation for 2 min for tougher tissue and 30 oscillation for 2 min for softer tissue.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Reagents
steps.instruction: Clean all surfaces and pipettes with RNase Away. Prepare 80% EtOH (approx. 45 mL for 96 samples) and Bead Binding Buffer (2x).

steps.title: Prepare Cleanup Beads (22% PEG)
steps.instruction: Prepare the 22% PEG Solution and combine it with washed Sera-Mag Speed Beads.

substeps.instruction: Add all ingredients for PEG Solution (22%) to a 50 mL falcon tube, withholding the total amount of water until PEG is completely solubilized.
Incubate at 40 °C and vortex regularly until PEG is completely dissolved.
Resuspend Sera-Mag Speed Beads and pipette 1000 µL into a 1.5 mL tube.
Place on magnet stand and remove storage buffer.
Add 1000 µL TE Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA), resuspend beads, place on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Repeat the wash step once more.
Add 900 µL TE Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA) and resuspend beads.
Add the washed beads to the PEG Solution (22%) and mix well. Aliquot and store at 4 °C for up to six months.

steps.title: Sample Preparation (Case 1: Direct Lysis)
steps.instruction: Prepare lysates from cells or tissue using Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Lysis Buffer; if sample volume exceeds 25% of total lysate, use 2x TCL buffer (Qiagen, #1070498) + 1% β-mercaptoethanol.
Add 100 µL Lysis Buffer to each well of a semi-skirted 96-well PCR plate.
Add cells (Min: 100, Opt: 10,000) or tissue (not exceeding 1000 ng RNA, normalized by weight). Homogenize difficult tissue with a tissue homogenizer.
Transfer 50 µL of lysate to a new plate; store backup plate at -80 °C.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion and Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Digest proteins and bind RNA to Cleanup Beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and 1 µL EDTA (25 mM) to each well.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 50 °C, then heat inactivate for 10 minutes at 75 °C.
Mix 50 µL sample with 100 µL Cleanup Beads (22% PEG).
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C (Room Temp).
Place on magnet stand until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 100 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet; incubate for 30 s, then discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 3 minutes (monitor to avoid over-drying).

steps.title: DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove genomic DNA from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL H2O and resuspend beads by vortexing vigorously (or pipetting if clumping occurs).
Add 15 µL DNase I Mix and mix by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 20 °C.
Heat inactivate DNase I by adding 1 µL EDTA (100 mM) and incubating for 5 minutes at 65 °C.
Place on magnet stand until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 100 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, then discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Add 4 µL H2O to the beads (can be combined with RT Mix by increasing water in Row 6 from 2.35 µL to 6.35 µL).
Add 5 µL Reverse Transcription Mix.
Add 1 µL Barcoded oligodT (E3V7NEXT) (10 µM) per well.
Incubate for 1 hour 30 minutes at 42 °C.

steps.title: cDNA Cleanup and Exonuclease I Treatment
steps.instruction: Purify cDNA and remove unused primers.

substeps.instruction: Place plate on magnet and pool supernatant of all wells into a 2 mL tube.
Add 10 µL Cleanup Beads (22% PEG) per sample (e.g., 240 µL for 24 samples).
Incubate for 5 minutes at Room Temp.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 1 mL 80% EtOH (adjust volume to cover beads), discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute in 17 µL UltraPure Water; incubate for 5 minutes at RT and transfer to new tube/plate.
Add 2 µL ExoI Buffer (10x) and 1 µL Exonuclease I; incubate (as specified).
Mix 20 µL sample with 16 µL Cleanup Beads (22% PEG) (1:0.8 ratio).
Incubate for 5 minutes at Room Temp.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 50 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute in 20 µL UltraPure Water; incubate for 5 minutes at RT and transfer to new tube/plate.
Add 30 µL Pre Amplification Mix to sample.
Incubate Pre Amplification PCR (adjust cycles based on input: e.g., ESCs ~10 pg RNA, T-cells ~1-2 pg RNA).
Mix sample with 40 µL Cleanup Beads (22% PEG) (1:0.8 ratio).
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 100 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute cDNA in 10 µL UltraPure Water; incubate for 5 minutes at RT and transfer to new tube/plate.

steps.title: cDNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify and check the quality of the amplified cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Quantify cDNA using Quant-iT PicoGreen dsDNA assay kit or Qubit (use 1 µL cDNA).
Quality check cDNA using Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with High Sensitivity DNA Analysis Kits.

steps.title: Fragmentation and Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Fragment the cDNA and ligate adapters.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Fragmentation Mix: Thaw Ultra II FS Reaction Buffer (break precipitates if seen), vortex Ultra II FS Enzyme Mix for 5-8 seconds, and keep on ice.
Vortex Fragmentation Mix for 5 seconds and immediately proceed to reaction.
Incubate fragmentation reaction with heated lid set to 75 °C (skip first incubation step after adding samples).
Add 6.7 µL Adapter Ligation Mix to each replicate.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 20 °C, then turn off heated lid.
Add 37.3 µL Buffer EB to samples.

steps.title: Library Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using SPRI Select beads.

substeps.instruction: Mix sample with 26 µL SPRI select beads; incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 76 µL supernatant to a clean well.
Mix supernatant with 10 µL SPRI select beads; incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Place on magnet until clear and discard supernatant.
Wash with 150 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute samples in 11 µL 0.1X TE (1X TE diluted 1:10 in water) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Indexing and Library PCR
steps.instruction: Add indices and perform final library amplification.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10.5 µL of samples to clean wells.
Add 1 µL Index Primer (Nextera i7, 5 µM) to each well.
Add 1 µL Index Primer (TruSeq i5, 5 µM) or universal primer P5NEXTPT5 to each well.
Add 12.5 µL Library PCR Mix (using Q5 Master Mix M0544L).
Incubate Library PCR (adjust cycles based on cDNA input).
Add 25 µL Buffer EB to Index PCR.
Mix Index PCR with 26 µL SPRI select beads; incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 76 µL supernatant to a clean well.
Mix supernatant with 10 µL SPRI select beads; incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C.
Place on magnet until clear and discard supernatant.
Wash with 150 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute in 15 µL UltraPure Water; incubate for 5 minutes, place on magnet until clear, and transfer to new well.

steps.title: Final Library QC and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform final quality control and submit for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Quantify and QC library using Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (HS DNA Kit); dilute if necessary to load no more than 2 ng onto the chip.
Submit samples for Illumina Sequencing: Min 8 cycles for Index Read (i7), 28 cycles for Read 1 (BC+UMI), and ~50 cycles for Read 2 (human/mouse).
Add 300 µL Lysis Buffer to a 2 mL tube (adjust for homogenizer).
Dilute homogenized lysate with Lysis Buffer to a total of 100 µL (target 100-500 ng RNA).
Add 135 µL Isopropanol; shake for 5 minutes at 20 °C at 1400 RPM.
Add 70 µL Cleanup Beads (22% PEG); shake for 5 minutes at 20 °C at 1400 RPM.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Add 300 µL Isopropanol; shake for 2 minutes at 20 °C at 1400 RPM.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 300 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 3 minutes.
Elute RNA by adding 20 µL H2O and resuspending beads; shake for 5 minutes at 20 °C at 1400 RPM.
Transfer 8 µL Extracted RNA to 96-well plate.
Add 2 µL DNase I Mix; incubate for 10 minutes at 20 °C.
Heat inactivate DNase I by adding 1 µL EDTA (100 mM) and incubating for 5 minutes at 65 °C.
Place on magnet until clear (~3 min) and discard supernatant.
Wash with 100 µL 80% EtOH while on magnet, discard supernatant.
Repeat wash step once more.
Air dry beads for 5 minutes.
Elute RNA with 15 µL H2O; incubate for 5 minutes at RT and transfer to new tube/plate.
Quantify RNA using Quantifluor RNA System (use 1 µL RNA).
Normalize samples to 4 ng - 40 ng (1 ng/µL to 10 ng/µL).
Transfer 4 µL of normalized RNA to a new plate.
